item.title: Community college enrollment outpaced university enrollment this school year
item.description: Experts explains there are numerous factors for developing trend.

item.title: Progressives remind everyone why they’re the most miserable beings on the planet
item.description: Progressives' constant negativity overshadows even celebratory moments in sports, like the U.S. men's hockey team's Olympic victory. Critics express discontent over patriotism and perceived endorsement of Trump, highlighting a trend where joy and success are met with complaints. Misery seems ingrained in their response to American achievements and symbols, overshadowing the collective pride.

item.title: Boy wins 3 events at California girls’ track meet, sets triple jump record
item.description: Jurupa Valley High School junior AB Hernández dominated a California girls' track meet, winning the triple jump, high jump, and long jump. His triple jump set a record of 40' 7½", nearly six feet ahead of the second-place competitor. Hernández has faced criticism for competing against girls but dismisses claims of unfairness.

item.title: Duke professor uses whiteness-based ‘necropolitics’ to lobby for gun control
item.description: ANALYSIS: White people have supported gun rights out of fear of the 'threat of racialized and potentially queering others'?

item.title: U. Oxford professor: ‘Anti-trans, queer panic’ fosters authoritarianism ‘under guise of child protection’
item.description: Aylon Cohen, a lecturer at the University of Oxford, advocates for political scientists to "queer" the discipline by challenging cisheteronormative assumptions. He argues that anti-trans policies, like Trump’s executive order, serve authoritarian agendas under the pretext of child protection, highlighting the need for queer scholarship amid growing threats to LGBTQ+ rights in today's political climate.

item.title: Sign stolen, thrown across room: Hostile crowd greets TPUSA at Wesleyan University
item.description: At Wesleyan University, a hostile crowd confronted the unofficial Turning Point USA chapter.

item.title: Another ‘Dead ICE Agents Can’t Kill’ flyer found at Penn State University
item.description: The graphic black and white flyer states 'Dead ICE Agents Can’t Kill' in capital letters above an image of an ICE agent hanging dead from a noose.

item.title: Winemaking scholar alleges Penn State faulted her for not being DEI enough: lawsuit
item.description: A Penn State University educator alleges she was denied two promotions due to insufficient adherence to the university's diversity, equity, and inclusion standards, according to a lawsuit.

item.title: ASU professor calls U.S. history a ‘400-year’ pattern of ‘reproductive oppression’
item.description: Fight over 'bodily autonomy' about who is seen as 'human enough,' professor said.
